title: SlimTools
description: makes important pvp tools slim and reduces fire on your screen
body:
SlimTools is a lightweight texture pack designed to enhance your Minecraft experience by reducing on screen clutter without compromising the game's visual integrity. Perfect for PvP, survival, or casual play, it offers a more streamlined and unobtrusive look for essential gameplay elements.

Whether you're in a fast paced fight or you are building a survival base, this pack will give you a clearer field of view, allowing for better awareness, cleaner screenshots, and less visual noise overall. Every texture has been adjusted with care to stay faithful to vanilla while improving usability and focus for you the player.
